title: Treasury Memo: Cash Pickup Exchange-Rate Margins, Rate Lock and Wire Deadline
content:
Cash Pickup local-currency payouts are priced at a margin below the mid-market rate. Each tier sets that margin, a principal threshold at or above which the margin is reduced, and the number of percentage points taken off at that threshold. The tier also sets how many hours a quoted rate stays guaranteed while funds are awaited, and how many hours an inbound wire has to arrive.

## Margin and lock schedule

| Cash Pickup tier | Margin below mid-market (percent) | Reduced-margin threshold (USD principal, at or above) | Points taken off at or above the threshold | Rate guaranteed for (hours from booking) | Inbound wire must arrive within (hours from booking) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 1.20 | 2000.00 | 0.10 | 96 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Express | 1.75 | 1500.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 1.35 | 3000.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 1.15 | 3000.00 | 0.15 | 48 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 1.60 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 0.85 | 10000.00 | 0.10 | 48 | 48 |

## Margin in effect on each side of the threshold

The reduced margin is the tier margin less the points shown. It is in effect when the principal is at or above the threshold.

| Cash Pickup tier | Principal below threshold | Principal at or above threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 1.20 | 1.10 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 1.75 | 1.65 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 1.35 | 1.25 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 1.15 | 1.00 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 1.60 | 1.60 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 0.85 | 0.75 |

Hypothetical boundary: on Cash Pickup Express a principal of 1499.99 carries 1.75 percent, and a principal of exactly 1500.00 carries 1.65 percent. On Cash Pickup Cardless ATM the points figure is 0.00, so the margin is 1.60 percent either side of 500.00.

A wire-arrival figure of 0 means no wire deadline applies on that tier. Only Cash Pickup Large Amount sets one, at 48 hours.
